fixes.explanation: I see where you were headed, baker, but there's no offering in these verses. Paul says Tychicus "…will tell you all the news about me." The man is carrying news, not a collection plate. Walk in asking for money when everybody's waiting on news and you'll clear that room fast.

That's right, baker. Paul says, "You have already received instructions about him: If he comes to you, welcome him." The word went ahead of Mark, so the Colossians knew what to do before he ever knocked. I spent years in a junk drawer waiting for somebody to open up, so a welcome that's ready before you arrive sounds like a dream to me.
